name: Minecraft
desc: 3D voxel world with redstone and an AI companion
meta: Explore, mine and build in a 3D voxel world right in your browser. Craft with redstone and pistons, and team up with an AI companion. Free, no download.

name: Golden Hare
desc: A sunrise bow hunt for rabbits in a misty pine forest
meta: Stalk rabbits through a sunlit pine forest at sunrise and hunt them with a bow. Sneak close, draw slow, lead your shot and catch the legendary Golden Hare. Free 3D first-person game in your browser.

name: The Hollow Pines
desc: Find the holy cross and destroy the ghost in a night forest
meta: A first-person horror game in a foggy pine forest at night. Search candle-lit shrines by torchlight for the holy cross while the ghost of Agnes Wren stalks and hunts you, then hold the cross up to her face. Free 3D game, best with headphones.

name: Paper Brook
desc: Row a paper boat down a sunlit forest brook
meta: Guide a tiny rower in a paper boat down a sunlit forest brook. Collect petals, dodge rocks and twigs, ride cascades and dry out in sunbeams on the way to the old mill. Free 3D game.

name: Coastline Rush
desc: Sunset sports-car racing around a tropical island
meta: Race sports cars on a cliff-top island highway at sunset. Handbrake drift for nitro and battle 7 CPU drivers past palms, a lighthouse and a glittering ocean. Free 3D racing game.

name: Neon Velocity
desc: Futuristic anti-gravity racing vs 7 CPU pilots
meta: Race anti-gravity hover-ships on a neon skyway through a night megacity. Drift for turbo, hit boost pads and beat 7 CPU pilots over 3 laps at 300+ km/h. Free 3D racing game.

name: Wisp Siege
desc: Tower defense on a floating isle at night
meta: Defend the Crystal Heart on a floating island at night. Build arc lamps, mortars, frost bells and tesla spires against 15 waves of wisps, golems and shades. Free 3D tower defense.

name: Orbit Breaker
desc: Breakout around a burning star core
meta: Breakout turned inside out. Your paddle orbits a burning star; shatter rings of crystal bricks, catch power-ups and keep the light inside the ring across 12 waves. Free 3D arcade game.

name: Lumen Links
desc: Fairy-lit 3D mini golf at dusk
meta: Play nine holes of 3D mini golf on a fairy-lit garden course at dusk, with a windmill, mushroom bumpers, lily ponds, a volcano and sliding gates. Free online, no download.

name: Nebula Drive
desc: Rhythm highway through a neon nebula
meta: A 3D rhythm game on a glowing highway through space. Hit D F J K to the beat of five synthwave tracks composed live in your browser, with holds, combos and overdrive. Free online.

name: Canyon Glide
desc: Fly a paper plane down an endless sunset canyon
meta: Glide a paper plane through an endless red-rock canyon at sunset. Dive for speed, ride thermals, thread rings and stone arches and skim the river. Free 3D flying game.

name: Prism Garden
desc: Bend beams of light to bloom lotus lanterns
meta: A 3D light puzzle on floating night-garden islands. Turn mirrors, split beams and fan white light through prisms so every lotus lantern gets its colour. 24 islands, free online.

name: Neon Strike
desc: Synthwave 3D bowling with real pin physics
meta: Bowl in a neon synthwave alley. Swipe to throw and curve the swipe to hook. Real pin physics, slow-motion strikes, a full 10-frame scoresheet and a CPU opponent. Free 3D bowling game.

name: Storm Beacon
desc: Guide ships past the reefs with a lighthouse beam
meta: Keep the lighthouse on a stormy night. Sweep the great beam across a heaving sea to guide blind ships past hidden reefs into harbour, with lightning and a fog horn. Free 3D game.

name: Sunrise Drift
desc: Hot-air balloon festival over fairy chimneys
meta: Fly a hot-air balloon at sunrise over a valley of fairy-chimney rock towers. Rise and sink to find the right wind, drop markers on targets and land softly. Free 3D browser game.

name: Frost Stone
desc: Curling on a frozen lake under the aurora
meta: Slide polished granite stones down a lantern-lit sheet of lake ice under the northern lights. Pick the curl, judge the weight and sweep against a CPU skip. Free 3D curling game.

name: Lantern Bow
desc: Japanese archery among cherry blossoms at dusk
meta: Draw a tall Japanese bow in a cherry-blossom garden at dusk. Read the wind, hit targets and a bronze gong, and shoot sky lanterns that burst into fireworks. Free 3D browser game.

name: Blackmoor
desc: Survival horror: escape the asylum in the dark
meta: A first-person survival horror game. Trapped in a dark asylum with a flashlight and something hunting you, find the fuses, restore the power and escape. Free online.

name: Sky Labyrinth
desc: Tilt a stone maze floating above the clouds
meta: Tilt a carved stone labyrinth floating above a sea of sunset clouds and roll a glass marble past holes, ice, gates and crumbling tiles. 24 levels, free online.

name: Flappy 3D
desc: Tap to flap through a bright 3D world
meta: Flap a little bird through glossy pipes in a bright low-poly 3D world that turns from day to sunset to a starry night as you score. Free, no download.

name: Tetris
desc: Stack and clear lines
meta: Play the classic falling-block puzzle free online. Rotate, stack and clear lines on desktop or phone, with keyboard or touch controls. No download needed.

desc: Merge tiles to reach 2048
meta: Play 2048 free online. Slide and merge numbered tiles to reach 2048 in this addictive number puzzle. Works on desktop and mobile, no download.

name: Tideglow
desc: Guide a glowing jellyfish up from the deep
meta: Swim a glowing jellyfish up through a deep-sea canyon. Dodge stinger curtains, urchins, eels and barracuda, and collect light on the way to the surface. Free 3D game.

name: Crystal Keep
desc: Build towers, hold the crystal
meta: A 3D tower defense game: build and upgrade crystal towers along winding paths and stop every wave before it reaches the keep. Several maps and difficulties, free online.

name: Marble Gambit
desc: 3D chess against a real engine
meta: 3D chess with carved marble and obsidian pieces in a moonlit conservatory. Five engine strengths, clocks, hints, undo and a full move list. Play the computer or a friend, free.

name: Night Market
desc: Run a cosy street-food market, one night at a time
meta: Run a cosy 3D street-food night market. Place stalls, hire vendors, serve hungry customers and grow your street, night after night. Free browser game.

name: Snake 3D
desc: The classic, on an island in a shimmering lake
meta: Play Snake in 3D: steer a glossy snake around a grassy island in a sparkling lake, eat apples and golden fruit, and grow as long as you can. Free online.

name: Chroma Drop
desc: Bounce down a spinning helix tower
meta: Spin a 3D helix tower and drop a bouncing ball through the gaps. Chain falls to catch fire and smash through rings. Free browser game, no download.

name: Neon Rush
desc: Synthwave lane runner
meta: Race down a neon synthwave highway in this 3D endless lane runner. Dodge, jump and collect to set high scores. Play free in your browser.

name: Jade Pavilion
desc: 3D mahjong solitaire in a garden pavilion
meta: Classic mahjong solitaire with carved 3D tiles in a lantern-lit jade pavilion. Match free pairs and clear the layout. Several layouts and themes, free to play online.

name: Gemfall
desc: Match-3 with glittering 3D gems
meta: A sparkling 3D match-3 puzzle: swap gems, chain cascades, make bombs and line blasts and clear 30 hand-made levels. Free online, no download.

name: Velvet Break
desc: 8-ball pool in a midnight lounge
meta: Play 8-ball pool on a 3D table in a low-lit lounge. Real ball physics with spin, a computer opponent with three strengths, two-player and practice modes. Free online.

name: Moonlake
desc: A calm fishing trip from dusk to night
meta: A relaxing 3D fishing game on a lake at dusk. Cast, wait for a bite, reel in 15 kinds of fish and fill your journal as day turns to a starry night. Free online.

name: Umbra
desc: Turn the sculpture till the shadow fits
meta: A 3D shadow puzzle: rotate a floating block sculpture until its shadow on the wall becomes a picture. Relaxing and clever. Free to play online.

name: Pong
desc: You vs the CPU
meta: Play classic Pong free online against the computer. Move your paddle, return the ball and outscore the CPU. Keyboard and touch controls.

name: Memory Match
desc: Find all the pairs
meta: Flip cards and find all the matching pairs in this free online memory game. Train your brain on desktop or mobile, no download needed.

name: Aegis
desc: Guard a 3D planet from meteors
meta: Defend a small blue planet from incoming meteors in this 3D arcade game. Tap to destroy them before they hit. Free to play in your browser.

name: Stratos
desc: Stack glass slabs into the sky
meta: Stack glass slabs into a tower that climbs past the clouds and into the stars. Time each drop perfectly. A free 3D stacking game for your browser.

name: Tic Tac Toe
desc: 2 players, one board
meta: Play Tic Tac Toe free online with a friend on the same device. Get three in a row to win. Simple, quick and works on any phone or computer.

name: Borealis
desc: Glide under the aurora
meta: Glide down a frozen river under the northern lights in this beautiful 3D flying game. Catch embers and avoid the ice. Free, no download.

name: Breakout
desc: Clear every brick
meta: Play Breakout free online. Bounce the ball with your paddle and smash every brick to clear the level. Classic arcade fun on desktop and mobile.

name: Minesweeper
desc: Flag the mines
meta: Play Minesweeper free online. Reveal safe squares, use the numbers to find the hidden mines and flag them all. Touch-friendly with a flag mode.

name: Prism Rush
desc: Endless neon highway runner
meta: Fly down an endless synthwave highway, dodge crystal blocks, jump laser gates and build combos. Unlock ship skins. A free 3D runner for your browser.

name: Classic Race 3D
desc: Race the coast road from sunset to night
meta: Play Classic Race 3D free in your browser. Weave through traffic on a seaside highway, chain near misses for bonus points and drive from sunset into a starry night. Keyboard or touch controls.

name: Ripple
desc: Steer a paper boat with pebbles
meta: A calm moonlit puzzle: drop pebbles into a pond and let the ripples steer a paper boat past rocks and lily pads. Free 3D browser game.

name: Ludo 3D
desc: Roll, race and knock rivals home on a 3D board
meta: Play Ludo in 3D on a polished wooden board: roll the die, race your four pawns home and knock rivals back to their yard. Play the computer or friends, free.

name: Skyputt
desc: Mini golf across floating islands
meta: Play 3D mini golf on floating islands above the clouds. Every nine-hole course is freshly generated, with ramps, bumpers and sand traps. Free online.

name: Space Invaders
desc: Blast the alien fleet
meta: Play a Space Invaders style shooter free online. Move, fire and blast the descending alien fleet before it reaches you. Desktop and mobile.

name: Whack-a-Mole
desc: Bonk moles in a living meadow, dodge the bombs
meta: Play Whack-a-Mole free online in a living 3D meadow. Bonk moles, grab golden ones for +5, dodge the bombs and build combos before time runs out.

name: Vortex
desc: 3D neon tunnel runner
meta: Skim the walls of a spinning neon tunnel in this fast 3D arcade runner. Find the gaps, grab the gold and survive. Free browser game.

name: Orbital
desc: Place worlds, bend the path, reach the light
meta: A gravity puzzle in space: place planets to bend a comet's path and guide it to the light. Clever levels plus a sandbox mode. Free online.

name: Simon
desc: Repeat the pattern
meta: Play Simon free online. Watch the colour sequence, repeat it back and see how long a pattern you can remember. A classic memory game.

name: Lumen Garden
desc: A little light goes a long way
meta: Rotate floating garden tiles to carry light from the golden spring to every bloom. A calm, hand-crafted 3D path puzzle. Free to play online.

name: Gearworks
desc: Steam-powered pinball
meta: Play steam-powered 3D pinball. Build boiler pressure, light the lock and trigger multiball for jackpots. A free pinball game in your browser.

name: Dino Run
desc: Jump the cacti
meta: Play an endless dino runner free online. Jump over the cacti and keep running as the speed rises. One-button fun for desktop and mobile.

name: Tessera
desc: Grow a hex-tile island
meta: Grow a little island one hex tile at a time. Match edges, connect rivers and complete quests in this relaxing 3D tile-placing game. Free online.

name: Dart Throw
desc: Aim, tap, bullseye
meta: Play a free online darts game. Time your throw, aim for the bullseye and rack up points on desktop or mobile.

name: Rewind Heist
desc: A time-loop stealth heist
meta: Pull off a heist with your own past selves. Record loops, let your ghosts replay them and team up across time to reach the vault. Free 3D puzzle.

name: Dart Wheel
desc: Land it, don't hit one
meta: Throw darts at a spinning wheel without hitting the ones already stuck in it. A quick, tricky timing game. Free to play online.

name: Starsling
desc: Gravity slingshot puzzle
meta: Fling a comet around planets, moons and black holes to collect three stars and reach the wormhole. A free gravity slingshot puzzle game.

name: Meadowhop
desc: 3D bunny meadow adventure
meta: Hop around a sunny 3D meadow as a bunny. Gather food, hide from danger and explore day by day. A cosy free browser adventure.

name: Grass in the Wind
desc: Windswept 3D grass field
meta: Watch a field of 3D grass sway in the wind, and tweak the wind, density and lighting yourself. A relaxing real-time WebGL toy.

name: Grass Wallpaper
desc: Live grass wallpaper
meta: A calming live wallpaper of rolling green hills and grass moving in the breeze. Runs in full screen in your browser.
